purpose: Teach: 恵比寿/坊主/生きがい/本命/クラフト/柵/ムーン/フランクフルト

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、恵比寿に、二号店、出す計画、本気で、検討しよか、立地、ええで、絶対に、勝負やで、本当に。
lines.en: Aoi — what if we seriously look at opening a second location in Ebisu? The spot is perfect. This could be it. This is the real deal.
lines.style: Energetic, Kansai lilt underneath. Leans forward with genuine excitement. Quick pace, no hesitation. Builds momentum toward the proposition. Warmth mixed with business-minded confidence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。お寺の坊主さん、お客様として、いつも、来てくださって、本当に、ありがたいです、葵で、感謝しております、いつも。
lines.en: Yes. The monk from the temple — he comes by as a regular customer, and I'm really grateful for that. Aoi is blessed by his visits.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Slight bow in the voice. Warm but composed. Acknowledges the question by pivoting to gratitude. Not deflecting — just noticing what matters most.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 料理は、僕の生きがいなんや、葵さん、本気で、頑張りたいんや、葵さんと、絶対、夢、叶えたいで、本当に、頼むで。
lines.en: Cooking is my whole life, Aoi. I want to give this everything. I want to make this dream real with you — I'm serious. Please.
lines.style: Vulnerable underneath the momentum. Slower pace on the confession. Opening attack is sincere, not performative. Hand reaches out (metaphorically). The 'please' at the end is genuine asking, not just persuasion.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。本命のシェフ、葵に、入ってくださることになりました、本当に、嬉しいです、葵で、メニュー、強化、できそうです。
lines.en: Yes. The main chef we wanted just agreed to join us at Aoi. I'm truly happy about it. This means we can really develop the menu now.
lines.style: Quiet relief and genuine pleasure. Steady breath, almost still. Eyes bright. She's sharing something real — not performing cheerfulness, but allowing herself to feel it. Slight warmth on 'truly happy.'

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 地元のクラフトビール、店内、置きたいんや、葵さん、お客様にも、本当に、喜んでもらえそうやで、絶対、売れるで。
lines.en: I want to stock local craft beers inside. Aoi, our customers are going to love it. This is going to move.
lines.style: Quick, confident, idea-running-ahead-of-itself energy. Kansai directness. Emphatic on the certainty ('this is going to move'). Building on momentum from the chef news. Slightly mischievous — like he's already picturing the success.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。お庭の柵、お洒落に、整えたいですね、葵で、お客様、入る時の、第一印象、本当に、大事ですから、はい。
lines.en: Yes. We should make the garden fence look refined and inviting. Aoi's first impression matters so much when customers walk in. That's really important.
lines.style: Practical, grounded. Switches focus to detail-work with quiet authority. Not bossy — just clear about what she notices. Slightly slower, more deliberate. The kind of person who sees what others miss.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ハネムーンに、行きたいなって、最近、奥さん、言うてるんや、葵さん、僕、考えなあかんかな、本当に、忙しすぎたで。
lines.en: My wife's been saying she wants us to take a honeymoon trip. Aoi, I need to think about that, don't I? Honestly, things have just been too hectic.
lines.style: Lighter tone — self-aware, a little rueful. Not complaining, more like noticing his own blindness. Wry smile underneath. The vulnerability is real but wrapped in humor. Trailing thought — like he's talking to himself as much as to Aoi.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。新メニューに、フランクフルトソーセージのアレンジ、入れたいですね、葵で、お子様、喜んでくださいそうですね、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. I'd like to add an arranged frankfurter dish to the new menu. Aoi's young customers will really enjoy something like that.
lines.style: Warm, thoughtful, almost tender. She's thinking about children — what makes them happy. Gentle pace. Soft eye-contact. This is genuine care, not just menu development. Closes with quiet confidence, like she's already seeing their faces light up.
